10 REM  SPRITE Test with animated sprites
15 HOME
16 FOR N = 1 TO 6
18 PRINT "POKING SPRITE ";N;" DATA TO BUFFER AREA..."
20 FOR I = 0 TO 239
22 READ P
24 POKE 38144 + I,P
26 NEXT
100 PRINT "STORING SPRITE ";N;" IN LANGUAGE CARD...": PRINT
115 &  STORE N,15,16,0
116 NEXT N
195 PRINT "STARTING ANIMATION...": PRINT

200 &  GR : &  VAL 0

234 XA(3) = 106:YA(3) = 45

260 &  DRAW NU(N),XA(N),YA(N): NEXT
268 & S1: &  SAVE 1,2: & S2
276 &  DEL NU(3): &  DEL NU(2): &  DEL NU(1)
278 IF  PEEK ( - 16384) > 128 THEN 890
285 FOR N = 1 TO 3
290 IF XA(N) > 162 THEN XA(N) = 66
300 IF YA(N) > 98 THEN YA(N) = 30
310 NEXT
320 GOTO 245
890 GET A$: &  TEXT : HOME
900 END
